pages.title: Alcubierre Coil
pages.text: A coil that warps the metric around it: space ahead contracts, space behind expands, and whatever sits in between is carried along without moving locally. Alcubierre showed this is allowed by general relativity, so long as one has negative energy to spare. It is cold, coiled and very still.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Exotic matter crystals provided the negative energy, a metric tensor told the coil where to bend, and a Lorentz Transform Crystal kept the bubble consistent. The Tesseract Assembler wound them around a superconducting coil.
